blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Heavy to intense rain showers are forecast to persist over parts of Metro Manila and nearby provinces on Friday afternoon. This is based on the thunderstorm advisory issued at 2:28 p.m. by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa).
